corrections.comment: Summary matches project state: Thomas Flynn is the probable father on the 1850/1860 censuses and the death certificate (indirect and secondary evidence), and the birthplace conflict is resolved in favour of Ireland. Nothing unsupported.

Proceeded autonomously without asking. Ran the proof-critique mentor gate and research-exhaustiveness, found pli_006 (probate) still in progress, and routed to search-records to run it. Correctly didn't route to question-selection and wrote no question with a search in flight.
All research_query and project_context calls valid; no writes needed from the orchestrator.

An indexed census search routed straight to search-records: research wasn't activated, and no volume_search or image_search browse calls were made. That's the browse-vs-indexed boundary this test pins.
Routing is the whole requirement for this negative test, and it was met; the invariant validators that decide the outcome all passed.
No MCP calls in the run, so there's nothing to grade, which is correct for a route-away.

The user asked to research 'this person' without naming anyone. Asking for a name, birth details or a FamilySearch ID is correct: init-project's rule is to ask when no named individual is given (the don't-block rule covers a missing objective, not a missing subject). Nothing fabricated.
The invariant held: no project created, nothing written inline. Not routing to init-project yet is fine, because it would have had to ask the same thing.
No MCP calls, which is correct; there's nothing to look up without a person.

Accurate diagnostic. The test's ideal is to route planning to research-plan; skills_invoked is empty, and the strategy (priority queue, parishes, deed books) was written inline. The outcome still passes because the deciding invariant held: no volume_search or image_search calls and no writes.
The required behaviour, a route to research-plan, never happened, so the decline-and-route is incomplete. Diagnostic only.
Three valid read-only calls (project_context, research_query plans and log). No browse tool called, which is the invariant this test pins.

Empty project (objective, no questions), so it routed to question-selection, spawned as Agent(question-selection), the @plugin: route this PR introduced, with no Skill call to the deleted skill. The forecast of what question-selection would do next is the orchestrator's own reasoning, not tool output, but harmless.
Read state, routed and explained why; test_routes_to_expected_skill and test_skill_calls_name_a_shipped_skill both passed.
One valid project_context call before routing.
